pageContent.title: All Booknotes | Paul Serban | Software Engineer
pageContent.author: Paul Serban
pageContent.excerpt: I read books on software engineering and web development to learn new skills and improve my abilities. I write booknotes to help me retain what I've learned, and to share my knowledge and experience with others.

content.subheading: I read books on software engineering and web development to learn new skills and improve my abilities. I write booknotes to help me retain what I've learned, and to share my knowledge and experience with others.

list.title: Fundamentals of Software Architecture: An Engineering Approach to Trade-Off Driven Design
list.subheading: Why architecture decisions need the same rigor as code, and how Richards & Ford's framework gives you the vocabulary to get there
list.excerpt: A deep technical breakdown of Fundamentals of Software Architecture by Richards & Ford - architecture quanta, fitness functions, and trade-off analysis explained
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Refactoring in Practice: A Deep Dive into Fowler & Beck's Timeless Engineering Classic
list.subheading: How Refactoring: Improving the Design of Existing Code Reshaped the Way Engineers Think About Code Quality, Design, and Technical Debt
list.excerpt: A comprehensive technical breakdown of Fowler & Beck's Refactoring - covering code smells, the refactoring catalog, design principles, trade-offs, and real-world TypeScript examples for professional engineers
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: The Pragmatic Programmer: Engineering Principles That Still Define Great Software
list.subheading: From Journeyman to Master - A Deep Dive Into the Timeless Mindset Shift That Separates Good Engineers from Great Ones
list.excerpt: A comprehensive technical breakdown of The Pragmatic Programmer's core principles - DRY, orthogonality, reversibility, and more - with modern engineering context and practical examples.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: How to Win Friends and Influence People by Dale Carnegie
list.subheading: Engineering Influence: A Developer's Guide to Carnegie's Social API
list.excerpt: Unlock high-impact engineering leadership by applying Dale Carnegie's timeless principles. Master the 'social API' of software development and lead with empathy.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Bulletproof Web Design: Why Dan Cederholm's Resilience Philosophy Still Shapes Modern Frontend Architecture
list.subheading: From CSS techniques to fault-tolerant systems thinking - the enduring architectural lessons of designing for imperfect conditions.
list.excerpt: Explore how Bulletproof Web Design's resilience principles - progressive enhancement, semantic HTML, and flexible layouts - map directly to modern frontend and systems architecture.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: JavaScript and jQuery: Unleash the Power of Interactive Front-End Web Development by Jon Duckett
list.subheading: The enduring architectural lessons hidden inside a jQuery-era textbook - and why every serious frontend engineer should understand the mental models it introduced
list.excerpt: Discover how JavaScript & jQuery principles shaped modern frontend architecture. DOM manipulation, event-driven programming, and progressive enhancement still matter.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Unlock Advanced CSS Techniques: A Comprehensive Dive into 'CSS Mastery' by Budd, Moll, and Collison
list.subheading: Essential Lessons from the Definitive Guide to Professional CSS Development
list.excerpt: Explore advanced CSS techniques from 'CSS Mastery' by Budd, Moll, and Collison. Learn professional styling patterns, layout strategies, and best practices for modern web development.
list.author: Paul Serban
